changes: Copy PR4731 geometry helpers and subpaged4D match; locally adapt its apply method to validate vLLM0.30 logical BHNC registration and normalize physical strides before strict page checks. Original hybrid-only dispatcher and 5D/MLA/Mamba rules remain unchanged; ratio-one and non-hybrid views retain the stock downstream normalization path.
validation_scope: CPU tests preserve every logical-page byte and reject invalid geometry. Real GPU model restore tests are separately required; the open PR is not an upstream release guarantee.

local_adaptation.contract: Registered axes are always [B,H,N,C]; NHD/HND describes physical stride order. Validate actual spec before metadata-only permute, then retain exact page-byte and contiguity checks.
